reasoning_summary: All build gates pass and the total (6.8) clears the 6.5 floor, so the opportunity is technically eligible for build_now. However, the cost-to-gain ratio of 3.588 massively exceeds the kill threshold of 0.6 from cost_gain_model.yaml, and even the optimistic scenario (1.794) is nearly 3× the kill line. The responsiveness_signal is only 2 (no outreach test run yet), meaning there is zero validated demand. With defensibility at 4 and an explicit note that OpenAI could ship native controls within 6–12 months, committing a build slot on unvalidated demand with terrible unit economics is premature. Defer one week to run a lightweight responsiveness probe (LinkedIn outreach to 50 engineering managers) and re-evaluate with actual signal data before committing operator time.
